rdfs:label: Profile
rdfs:comment: An ActivityStreams Object that describes another Object — typically supplemental information about an actor (Person, Application, Group, Organization or Service) (a richer biography, alternate display data) layered on top of the actor's primary record.
notes: A Profile uses `as:describes` to point at the Object it documents. Useful when the descriptive payload is large or evolves independently of the actor's identity record (e.g. a long bio with media attachments) — the Profile is fetched separately and may be cached, signed, or replicated apart from the actor. This is the AS2 Profile object (a content object pointing at its subject via as:describes). It is NOT the Solid WebID profile document — for that use urn:solid:PersonalProfileDocument.
